newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIA'S TRITSCHER TEARS LIGAMENT.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIA'S TRITSCHER TEARS LIGAMENT.

text.p: Austrian skier Michael Tritscher will miss the rest of the season after suffering a knee injury when he fell during the first leg of a men's World Cup slalom in Italy on Tuesday.
Austrian team surgeon Christian Schenk said Tritscher had torn his right patella ligament and would not be able to race again for four months.
Tritscher said he fell after suddenly feeling a sharp pain in his right knee. He was flown to Austria for a medical examination immediately afterwards

"This is awful. I only just managed a successful return from injury and now this," said a disappointed Tritscher, who missed most of last season after tearing his left cruciate ligament exactly a year ago to the day.
However, the 31-year-old veteran said he was not thinking about retirement. "I already proved that I am capable of making a comeback. Biologically I feel like I am 25 years old," he said.
